articleTitle: Virtual reality system for industrial training
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The virtual training system is mainly aimed at practical problems such as highly training costs, much producing time, and repeated training for various dangerous production courses in the industrial manufacturing fields. This project builds a realistic virtual environment and provides a reliable visual operations for industrial production. The system includes technical support such as reproduction of real producing environment, multi- dimensional data input, demonstration of various processes, establishment of interactive feedback system, and error demonstration. The construction of this system provides a solution for the training of workers in industrial production enterprises and the improvement of industrial safety production efficiency and quality.

articleTitle: Image Mosaic and Hybrid Fusion Algorithm Based on Pyramid Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Image mosaic and fusion is the key technology in the field of panoramic image. Aiming at the problems of ghosting and color change in the process of image fusion, this paper proposes an image mosaic and hybrid fusion algorithm based on pyramid decomposition. Firstly, the image is decomposed into Gauss pyramid by Gaussian decomposition; then the Laplacian pyramid of image is obtained by the difference operation based on the Gaussian pyramid; according to the characteristics of high-frequency component and low-frequency component of different decomposition layer, different fusion methods are selected for hierarchical fusion, that is, for the high-frequency component in the image, the local maximum variance criterion is selected for fusion, the low-frequency components are fused by weighted average algorithm. Finally, the reconstructed image is obtained by inverse Laplace transform. The improved algorithm can deal with the difference of brightness better in detail, ensure the active degree of color, and the fusion result has no ghosting phenomenon, and the transition is more smooth and natural.

articleTitle: A novel SLAM method for laparoscopic scene reconstruction with feature patch tracking
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: As one of the Minimally Invasive Surgery (MIS), laparoscopy is widely applied in gastrointestinal surgery. Benefits from its minimally invasive procedure and fast postoperative rehabilitation for patients. However, it is a huge challenge for surgeons to operate slender surgical instruments under a limited field of view taken by laparoscopy which requires the surgeon to have rich surgical experience. In laparoscopic surgeries, an accurate 3D reconstruction mode with internal anatomy structure and laparoscopic positions in the abdominal cavity can effectively help the surgeon to reduce the dependence on surgical experience. In addition, reconstructing the structure of the surgical scene is also a key step for data registration in surgical navigation and augmented reality surgery. In this paper, a novel Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) method based on feature patch tracking by Kernel Correlation Filter (KCF) is proposed for 3D dense point clouds reconstruction, which is called KCF-SLAM. It reconstructs the laparoscopic surgery scene accurately and densely under stereo laparoscopic conditions. The proposed method is validated on a public in-vivo data set captured by a stereo laparoscope. Compared with the feature-based SLAM, the proposed method can work efficiently when the image texture is missing or insignificant. The results suggest that the proposed method can reconstruct the dense point cloud of laparoscopic scene stably and accurately.

articleTitle: 5G+VR industrial technology application
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The SYVR virtual assembly 5G integrated solution mainly provides virtual technical support for the major industrial manufacture fields. Based on the physical simulation research results, the virtual assembly system focuses on the virtual training and testing and the design of the simulation process for the equipment producing fields. The system functions include constructing stable virtual scenarios, capturing multidimensional industrial data, simulating virtual assembly process, and presenting the data visualization results. The SYVR uses a high-speed network environment to build industrial application scenarios, provide virtual business training and other key business solutions for the actual production. The entire virtual environment solution could reduce production costs and improve production efficiency for the intelligent development of the industrial equipment.

articleTitle: AR Creator: A Mobile Application of Logic Education Based on AR
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: With the rapid development of augmented reality technology in recent years, the application of mobile Ar has become more and more extensive. This paper introduces an AR mobile application based on AR Foundation which aims to popularize AR life style, let users experience the fun of AR. The project mainly through scanning the real plane, after the recognition is successful, the virtual object can be placed on the real world plane, and then the function operation can be carried out by clicking the corresponding button on the mobile phone screen, so as to realize the logic conversion. The original intention of the project is to let children combine hands-on ability and visual effects, so as to better realize the multidimensional development of intelligence.

articleTitle: AI and AR Based Interface for Piano Training
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Multimedia teaching patterns for piano performance have gained great momentum benefiting from the rapid development of virtual reality (VR)/augmented reality (AR) technologies in recent years. Considerable efforts are made to achieve high-fidelity and fluency 4D visualization for the actions of hands. However, it is still challenging to effectively generate demonstration animation for large batches of music, especially for complex music requiring professional playing skills. We propose an AR-based individual tutorial system for piano training which is competent in automatically generating hand action animations and displaying animations with real pianos using head-mounted displays. Given a piece of music as input, our system first predicts the correspondence between target keys and fingers using a Hidden Markov model. Based on the prediction results, we employ musical prior knowledge to establish a generation mechanism for hand actions that aims to coordinate arm and finger motions taking naturalness and convenience into consideration.

articleTitle: Hello, Chinese Ethnic and Folk Dances
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: China has a wealth of ethnic and folk dances, which are our national precious intangible cultural heritage. It is our obligatory responsibility to protect and inherit these precious treasures. This work aims to apply computer graphics and augmented reality (AR) techniques to the dynamic display of folk dances. We use the real motion capture data of the dance artists to drive virtual characters' dance performances. Meanwhile costumes and stage scenes with ethnic characteristics help to foil the atmosphere of dance. Our work not only solves the problem of unable to transmit motion capture data due to copyright restrictions, but also has a good sense of immersion and interactivity, which plays an active role in promoting the protection and inheritance of action-type intangible cultural heritage.

articleTitle: Skin Lesion Segmentation Based on Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Dermatological segmentation has always been a hot topic in medical imaging. At present, many algorithms have achieved good results in the segmentation of skin diseases, such as super-pixel segmentation and U-Net network. The method we used in this paper is improved based on the instance segmentation model, Mask R-CNN. Firstly, we have trained the classification branch in Mask R-CNN in advanced. Secondly, we made some adjustments to the parameters of Mask R-CNN. These two changes ensure that our method has higher segmentation accuracy and detection accuracy than traditional Mask R-CNN. The data set used in this paper comes from ISIC (International Skin Imaging Collaboration). Experiment results demonstrate that the segmentation effect of our method on skin lesion images is better than the traditional Mask R-CNN.

articleTitle: An Improved MeshCNN with Active Learning for Anatomical Labeling of the Circle of Willis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The identification and labeling of the Circle of Willis in cerebral arteries is an important part of cerebral aneurysm treatment, which can assist physicians in making accurate diagnostic analysis. Most studies are based on manual extraction of vessel features, which obtain the low accuracy of labeling vessels with high topological variability in the Circle of Willis. In this paper, we propose a method combining transfer learning and active learning for automatic anatomical labeling of cerebral vessels. Firstly, the neural network model is transferred to automatically extract vessel features. Secondly, we use different sampling strategies of active learning to select some most valuable samples. The information of selected samples is fully utilized to improve the accuracy of machine learning modeling. Finally, in order to achieve automatic labeling of cerebral blood vessels, the downstream task model of transfer learning is integrated into active learning to construct a learning model. The experimental results present that the proposed method improves the labeling accuracy as much as possible while reducing the burden of manual labeling. It can effectively solve the Circle of Willis automatic anatomical labeling problem. In addition, the method can be better applied to vessels with high topological variability.

articleTitle: Smart City Construction and Rendering Based on Virtual City Space
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In response to the cultural development strategy put forward by my country in the past two years, this paper combines virtual reality technology with unique rendering technology, uses texture mapping technology to construct virtual city roaming scenes, ray tracing algorithm creates various lighting rendering effects, and dynamic image algorithm realizes images Sharpen, automatically adjust the brightness of the texture. Through the above technology, the ancient style and modernity are merged to create a quiet and elegant future virtual architectural scene.

articleTitle: Cloud Rendering Scheme for Standalone Virtual Reality Headset
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This paper proposes a cloud rendering framework for three-degree-of-freedom-oriented standalone virtual reality headset which worked on wireless network to solve the shortcomings of VR devices using cables connections and insufficient local rendering capabilities. This framework not only solves the problem of the VR experience being affected by cables, but also improves the image quality of the standalone headset. In this solution, we use the standalone headset as the client, the Unreal Engine 4(UE4) as the rendering engine and the server combining Asynchronous TimeWarping (ATW) and Fixed Foveated Rendering (FFR) technology to achieve cloud rendering. The results show that the solution can support the 2560×1440 resolution. Experiments show that the framework can significantly improve the image quality of the standalone headset, and it can also maintain a frame rate of 70Hz.

articleTitle: The design of virtual town based on TwinMotion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Along with the continuous development of urbanization, the development of modern cities has led to the following problems: 1. The natural environment is destroyed in large quantities, forming the confrontation between man and nature 2. The parts of the cities are far from the natural environment Therefore, in view of the long-term development of human beings and urban construction, with the construction of the idea about the planning tradition of landscapes and culture[1], we design a project that takes the natural landscape and the beauty of the city into account, which is called Urban Town, and provides a design idea for the construction of a new city. Urban Town is composed of several regions, including urban areas and rural areas. Urban Town is a fictional urban area, which aims to plan under the premise of integrating natural landscape. The urban design can carry out the transformation of natural environment residence and work properly according to the actual demand. Residents can enjoy natural beauty and improve their life experience. We rendered the scene by designing the scene using the realtime rendering software TwinMotion. We designing and making architectural models in blender and sketchup, importing the model into TwinMotion and giving the model a map material.

articleTitle: Speech Rehabilitation System for Hearing Impaired Children Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In the field of public welfare, the rehabilitation of hearing-impaired children is widely concerned by the society. Virtual reality technology integrates simulation and electronic information technology, and uses computer to create a simulation environment to immerse users in the environment. This paper introduces a speech rehabilitation system for hearing-impaired children based on virtual reality technology. The system can not only help hearing-impaired children with hearing rehabilitation training, but also reduce the difficulty of rehabilitation training. The system uses virtual 3d animation to reproduce the common communication scenes in daily life, and applies the dialogue in the scene and the pronunciation actions of monosyllabic words in Chinese pinyin to the language rehabilitation training of deaf children. The experimental results show that the systematic simulated pronunciation can effectively simulate the movement of the vocal organs, and can improve the language ability of hearing impaired children in the training process, which has high application value.

articleTitle: Parking preview based on Unity3D
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In order to allow car owners to quickly and conveniently find parking spaces in unfamiliar parking lots and keep track of the car conditions. This project uses Unity3D professional technology to design and develop “the application of Unity3D- based virtual reality technology in parking”, which combines virtual reality technology and data visualization functions. The virtual parking system will help improve parking difficulties and other problems, and aims to serve society.

articleTitle: Comfort Evaluation of Stereo Images Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Aiming at the difficult problem that how to evaluate comfort of stereo images effectively, this paper proposes a visual comfort evaluation model of stereo images based on machine learning. The job is conducted based on a focus area in images. The disparity map is calculated from a pair of stereo images. A primary salient area is obtained by the GBVS algorithm from right eye image, and the final stereo salient area is generated from both parallax information and primary salient area. Next, multiple types of features in the region are extracted. At last, the support vector regression model is used to predict the visual discomfort score. The experimental result shows that the proposed objective evaluation model is close to the subjective evaluation value, and it has achieved better results.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Learning of Depth Estimation Based on Attention Model from Monocular Images
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: At present, the accuracy of unsupervised monocular depth estimation method is not high, the outline is not clear. To solve this problem, we propose a jointly unsupervised learning framework for monocular depth and camera motion estimation from video sequences in this work. Specifically, we introduce an Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) module and an attention model. The former module is able to encode multi-scale contextual information by probing the incoming features with filters or pooling operations at multiple rates and multiple effective fields-of-view, while the latter model enables the network to maintain the shape of objects and enhance edges of the depth map. Experiments on KITTI and Cityscapes datasets show that our method can effectively improve the accuracy of the monocular depth estimation, solve the depth estimation boundary blur problem and preserve the details of the depth map.

articleTitle: Improved Robust Hand-Eye Calibration Algorithm Based on Data Optimization and Filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The mathematical model of hand-eye calibration is an important model in machine vision area. But in many other areas, the mathematical model of hand-eye calibration can be also used to get the transformation relationship of two frames, such as computer-aided diagnosis. The quality of input data is an important factor for the hand-eye calibration algorithm to obtain accurate result. Even if the algorithm is excellent, the unsatisfactory data will have a significant influence on the accuracy of the algorithm. Therefore, a data filtering rule is employed to eliminate the outliers in data sets in this paper. Firstly, an initial result is obtained by the robust hand-eye calibration algorithm using dual quaternion. Then, the outliers are filtered by using the data filtering rule. In this paper, we use l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> matrix norm to quantify the error values that are obtained by AX-XB. By sorting the errors from small to large, the threshold is set to filter the data with large error values. Finally, the filtered data is used to calculate the new result by the robust hand-eye calibration algorithm. We implement the backprojection experiments to verify the validity of the proposed method. The proposed method is more accurate and it has a better robustness. Compared with the robust hand-eye calibration algorithm with dual quaternions, the accuracy of the result is improved by 50% after filtering the data.

articleTitle: NOBOOK VR Experiment Test
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: NOBOOK VR experiment test is an experimental virtual simulation application, with two modes of experimental practice and experimental exam. It is devoted to experimental operation teaching and practice, and helps students to quickly increase the scores in the middle school experiment and test.

articleTitle: Large-scale 3D Modeling Based on UAV Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: With the rapid progress of the construction of “digital city”, as the basic data of geographic information framework, urban 3D model has been paid more and more attention. Although the traditional 3D modeling method can be well controlled in the fineness of the model, it can not meet the needs of constructing the urban 3D model quickly. After many years of exploration and research, photogrammetry technology, with its rapid and efficient data acquisition ability, makes a large range of urban 3D modeling possible. However, because aerial photography acquires vertical images, there are often ground objects occlusion, shooting dead corners and so on, which leads to incomplete acquisition of side texture information of buildings, thus affecting the quality of 3D models. On this basis, a new method, tilt photogrammetry, is derived.

articleTitle: Sketch-based 3D shape retrieval via attention
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: How to retrieval 3D shapes effectively is a longstanding problem in the field of computer vision. The last years, with the popularity of touch devices such as mobile phones and tablets, sketch-based 3D shape retrieval has become a more efficient way of 3D shape retrieval. This paper proposes a sketch-based 3D shape retrieval framework via attention. First, each 3D shape is rendered into multiple images, and the important information of each view is enhanced through the attention network, while the other information of each view can be suppressed. This method is used as the basis for view fusion instead of choosing the best view. It helps to get comprehensive information about the 3D shape from multiple views, and can generate more robust 3D shape feature descriptors. Then the 3D shape features and sketch features are similarly learned to further narrow the gap between samples of the same categories in different domains, and increase the discrimination of samples of different categories in the same domain, which can better improve retrieval performance. The method in this paper has been verified on the dataset SHREC2013, confirming that the retrieval effect is better than some methods.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Based on Ensemble Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: To address high complexity of manually extracted features in traditional methods and insufficient classification of single convolutional neural network(CNN), this paper designs and implements an ensemble convolutional neural network-based model to improve the recognition rate. The ensemble network model is constructed by training two different subnetwork models and concatenating together the different features extracted from them. Experiments are conducted on the public dataset FER2013, and from the experimental results it is clear that the ensemble network enhances the recognition rate by about 0.4% over the individual network. It is shown that the convolutional neural network model based on the ensemble has a stronger recognition ability.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Matching of 3D Face Model Based on Facial Landmark Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Building a high-quality 3D face model is one of the important issues in computer graphics. High-fidelity 3D face model can be obtained through 3D reconstruction methods from measured data, but the reconstructed models are often flawed with missing measurement data. In order to improve the usability and robustness of the 3D face models, repair and optimization of the face model are critically important. The traditional solutions rely on geometric heuristics to complete repairing work. Considering the characteristics of the face, it is possible to utilize the semantic information to improve the quality of repairing process for the three-dimensional face models, thereby improving the accuracy of the repaired models. In this paper, we combine artificial intelligence and computer graphics methods, and proposes a feature extraction and matching of 3D face model method based on facial landmark detection. Our method combines the facial feature recognition algorithm of 2D facial image and the mapping relationship of 3D face mesh model, and realizes the function of semanticsegmentation and extraction of the 3D face model features. It can be used for the next step of 3D face mesh repair research.

articleTitle: Multi-touch Simulation System for Sand Painting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In this project we are aimed at developing a humanmachine interaction system of sand painting to make sand painting learning easily and to realize a more popular art form. Up to now, our sand painting system can completely achieve simulations of 10 types of common gesture techniques of sand painting. An all-in-one machine with multi-touch interaction is adopted for sand painting system to provide a better user experience. By selecting different sand painting simulating techniques and sand colors, users can carry out multi-touch interaction-based sand painting on the touch screen.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Pottery Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This work is mainly based on the research of virtual pottery teaching environment based on gesture interaction. A set of virtual pottery gesture recognition library is developed through Leap Motion equipment research.

articleTitle: Architectural Visualization of Noufu Church Based on Twinmotion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The classic building, Nuofo Church, designed and produced in Twinmotion is the visual representation created by the designer in order to spread and protect the architectural art and culture. The following part will introduce the work from the perspectives of problem description, novelties, system architecture, and technical highlights. Twinmotion is the tool of adding miraculous color to works.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Custom Interactive Art Space
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Virtual reality interactive art space is a real-time interactive display tool based on the Unity3D engine, and uses virtual reality technology to solve long-standing design problems in the traditional space design industry, reducing the waste of resources in the design process and enhancing the display effect of design works, in order to achieve long-term social benefits and artistic appreciation value.

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction Method Based on Aerial Sequence of UAV
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In response to the current problems of poor 3D reconstruction and the inability to guarantee the quality, this paper proposes a research on 3D reconstruction methods based on drone aerial photography sequences. Mainly through the SIFT algorithm, extract the same pixel matching points in each image sequence, and then use SFM technology to complete the sparse point cloud reconstruction, and finally use the CMVS algorithm to achieve point cloud clustering classification, reduce overlapping data, and use the PMVS algorithm to complete the dense point cloud reconstruction. Experiments show that the high-altitude remote sensing image reconstructed by the proposed method has a good effect and guarantees the quality of the model.

articleTitle: A Virtual Reality Cycling System Based On Multi-Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Cycling is a popular sport, however, many enthusiasts can't go outside for the weather and traffic accidents. In order to solve this problem, we propose a virtual reality cycling system with multi-sensor fusion. Hall sensors, gyroscopes and other sensors are used to capture the cycling speed and rotation angle. Using Bluetooth to exchange realtime data with the mobile virtual reality scene, we can monitor the movement consumption and the speed and distance of the bicycle in real time. In order to simulate the natural wind effect during cycling and enhance the cycling experience, the real time speed of the bicycle is used to drive the motor to generate the natural wind from the fan. Finally, the virtual simulation scene of bicycle riding is built through the virtual reality environment of mobile phone, and the indoor VR cycling effect is realized.

articleTitle: The Interactive Art Design of Peking Opera Face Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Peking Opera is the most influential drama in China and one of the three performing systems in the world. The art of Facial design is the essence of Peking Opera. However, with the acceleration of the pace of life of the times, the art of Peking Opera needs innovation and development more urgently. Combining traditional Peking opera culture with popular virtual reality technology to interpret this ancient art in this way is a kind of inheritance. Based on virtual reality technology, this paper mainly uses the Unity3D engine to design a Peking Opera facial expression simulation system. We have studied the design of the BlendShape and completed the model wiring based on the Features of facial muscle when the expression changes. We use the OPenCV and Dlib library to detect and sample the real- time face images obtained by the camera, and then establish the function mapping between the feature points and the weight values of BlendShape to control the position change, rotation angle, expression change of Peking Opera face, so that the model could fits the face as much as possible.

articleTitle: Metal Surface Defect Detection Based on Weighted Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The texture of the metal surface is irregular, and the distinction between defect feature and texture feature is not obvious, which brings great difficulties to automatic defect detection. Traditional methods of defect detection have low accuracy, difficult design, and poor robustness, and the speed and accuracy of existing deep learning methods cannot reach the high standards in the factory. In this paper, a YOLOv4 defect detection algorithm based on weighted fusion is proposed. It uses a GAN network to generate a mask map in real time, and performs weighted fusion of the feature maps in YOLOv4. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves the recognition accuracy by 1% without seriously affecting the speed of the YOLOv4.

articleTitle: Rating Duration Analysis for Subjective Quality Assessment of 360° Videos
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Due to large advances in immersive media systems offering increased resolutions, frame rates, and dynamic ranges, applications such as watching 360° videos on head-mounted displays (HMDs) have become more popular. To assist the development of immersive media applications, subjective tests of 360° videos on HMDs are needed to obtain a ground truth on the quality as perceived by the end-users. The absolute category rating (ACR) method, standardized for subjective quality assessment of conventional videos, has also been used for assessing the subjective quality of 360° videos. Recently, the modified ACR (M-ACR) method has been proposed aiming at subjective quality assessment of 360° videos. Several subjective test campaigns have been conducted to assess the ACR and M-ACR method for evaluating 360° videos covering a wide range of resolutions, bit rates, and quantization parameters. The opinion scores given by the participants in these subjective tests are accumulated to mean option scores (MOSs) and confidence intervals. However, to the best of our knowledge, a detailed statistical analysis and comparison of the rating durations associated with casting opinion scores for 360° test videos in the ACR and M-ACR method has not been reported in the literature. In this paper, we therefore provide a rating duration analysis for subjective quality assessment of 360° videos for the ACR and M-ACR method. The results support experimental designs for 360° video quality assessment and include the following findings: 1) The mean rating duration is shorter for the ACR method, 2) The difference of the standard deviation of rating durations versus MOS between the ACR and M-ACR method is insignificant, 3) For a given mean rating duration, however, the standard deviation is smaller for the M-ACR method indicating that the quality rating task is easier to execute than with ACR. 4) The period to be allocated in subjective tests for rating 360° videos should exceed 5 s but can be kept below or set equal to 10 s.

articleTitle: Community building 3D modeling based on UAV photography
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In recent years, tilt photogrammetry technology has been widely used in surveying and mapping field because of its good flexibility, high production efficiency, short cycle time and low cost. The traditional topographic mapping requires a lot of manpower, material resources and financial resources, which not only wastes a lot of resources, but also leads to low efficiency. The application of 3D model obtained by UAV tilt photogrammetry to campus has great advantages and good application prospect. Taking the 3D model of community building for Changchun University of Architecture and Civil Engineering as an example, it is of practical significance to use technology to model, which has certain practical significance.

articleTitle: VR multi-class
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: VR multi-dimensional classroom is a complete VR immersive course learning system developed and launched by Zhihai Yuntian. Students can put on a helmet and have an immersive learning experience, while teachers can control the course process through the teacher's side.

articleTitle: Design and production of monster hunting game based on virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The introduction of VR technology into game design has become an important research content for the development of the game market. In order to enhance the sense of real experience and immersion of the game, this article starts from the concept and practical advantages of VR technology application, establishes a spatial model to filter and match the data, combines the feature points of the image with the function in OpenCV, and finally uses the panoramic image to generate Technology generates panoramic images of the game, and uses VR technology combined with real life as the background to develop a game called “Arrest the Little Monster”.

articleTitle: Geometric Correction for Projection Image Based on Azure Kinect Depth Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In order to improve the universality of the projector to the irregular projection surface environment, a geometric distortion correction algorithm for projection images based on Azure Kinect depth data was proposed. The algorithm used Azure Kinect to collect the color information and depth information of the irregular projection surface, obtained the largest visible projection area from the color image, and calculated the target projection position according to the ratio of the projection area. Then the natural feature matching set was divided into regions according to the depth information layering rules of the irregular projection surface, and the unknown regions without natural feature coverage in the depth information were clustered to the known hierarchical regions. Finally, the homography matrix was obtained by solving each depth layered plane, and the set of homography matrix was constructed to correct the geometric distortion of the projection image, so as to obtain the expected projection image without distortion. Through the comparison and analysis of the experimental data, it could be seen that the correction algorithm can not only obtain a projection display that meets the human visual perception, but also correct the feature error between the output image and the original image to the sub-pixel level.

articleTitle: Colored Sand Painting Simulation Based on Detail Preservation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: To get rid of the limitations of a real sand table which is not portable and has high professional requirements of sand painting techniques, also to enhance the naturalness and interest of users' experience, an algorithm of colored sand painting simulation is proposed. The algorithm consists of two main parts: (1) Colored sand painting generation method. It uses HSV and RGB models to express color information. (2) Details processing method. It takes advantages of principle of mass conservation to simulate the sand transfer process and random perturbations for various realistic painting techniques. The experimental results indicate that our algorithm can not only present technique details in a realistic, effective, and realtime manner, but also simulate colored sand painting with fine details.

articleTitle: Human-Object Interaction in AR
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: With the developments of augmented reality, there are more and more electronic games which take the application of augmented reality. However, a lot of these games lack the influence made by realistic scenes, and connection between realistic objects and the process of games. So the project provides a solution regard to design human-object interaction and game content. Besides, the paper introduces some ideas about the combination between human-object interaction with various game factors.

articleTitle: Digital Virtual Museum
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In order to solve some shortcomings of 3D scanning technology in cultural relic reconstruction, we extract 2D-2D feature points from two images, calculate camera posture by mathematical calculation, encapsulate them into algorithm, Automatic calculation of 3D space coordinates of cultural relics, and then transform them into point cloud image; construct cultural relic model through 3D gridding of single image prediction as supervision constraint [1]; use fuzzy Detection and dynamic weight distribution algorithm for texture reconstruction [2]; texture mapping and texture splicing methods are used to attach the texture with the highest similarity for cultural relics; linear exposure is used to adjust the light intensity under the premise of ensuring the light source, and V-Ray spherical light, point light source and spotlight are used to restore the effect of Museum exhibition hall as real as possible, so as to achieve a higher similarity of cultural relics reconstruction.

articleTitle: The Research and Realization of VR for The School-based Textbooks of school for the Mentally Retarded
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Education has always been the focus of national attention, and special children education is a very important part of the education industry. Traditional education forms lack interest and immersion, making it difficult for these special children to truly understand a piece of knowledge. With the development of science and technology, virtual reality (VR) technology has entered people's field of vision, and “VR + education” has become the focus of attention. This article focuses on special children with intellectual deficiencies, and uses the characteristics of VR to design an educational VR software system that is easy for students to understand. Using C# language to write programs to achieve human-computer interaction, two virtual scenes with a high degree of realistic reproduction were created through Unity3D. In the scenes, there are four classes: math class, Chinese class, English class and life class. It also has an examination function and gives feedback on the results of the examination. The software system has a good feedback mechanism, which allows teachers and parents to understand the children's learning situation in time. The system can complete a series of complex human-computer interaction functions, truly combine virtual and reality, relieve fatigue through children's physical or psychological transfer behavior, and help children truly achieve efficient learning.

articleTitle: Virtual simulation system of paste filling for green mining of metallic mine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Based on the actual industrial site and roadway engineering layout of the mine, this work constructs a high-precision 3D virtual simulation roaming scene of metal mine filling production, and stereoscopically reproduces the paste filling process so that students can establish a global understanding of the filling production environment, technological process, key steps and main equipment. This work breaks the limitations of the teaching method which mainly focuses on indoor experimental teaching and supplemented by industrial experimental demonstration, creates a new way to adapt to the characteristics of mining personnel training in the new era, creates a virtual reality, all-weather, online and offline integrated learning mode, platform and environment, and explores new methods, new directions and new ways for traditional industry teaching reformation.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of immersive ink art
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Nowadays, with the continuous development and progress of computer graphics, computer technology provides a new medium form for traditional ink art. This new form is mainly to use 3D animation modeling and Unity3D software platform to process the ink-style rendering of the 3D model. First, by extracting feature lines and local pixel regions as the basic outline of the object, the surface texture material of the object is pasted with ink-style texture material to form a simple ink effect. And then the camera is adjusted or Gaussian blur processing, depth and the processing of normal texture makes the ink and wash effect more realistic, achieving the fusion of modern digital technology and traditional ink and landscape painting.

articleTitle: Application of Gesture Recognition Fusion Algorithm Based on Double LeapMotion in Hand Function Rehabilitation in Large Space
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: With the development of human-computer interaction technology, due to the advantages of virtual interaction and the quantification of motion capture data, gesture recognition controllers such as LeapMotion have been introduced into hand function rehabilitation training. However, when used individually, its measuring angle and measuring range are limited and cannot be applied in a large space. In this paper, the dual LeapMotion combination is used to unify the data in the two coordinate systems into the same coordinate system, thereby increasing the acquisition space range and space field of view. Through coordinate system conversion, the converted data is consistent with the actual test action. This method can be extended to multiple LeapMotion combinations.

articleTitle: Application of 3D rendering in Twinmotion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: 3D rendering is a heavy task for virtual reality models in order to reduce the amount of work in this part. The paper describes the process of rendering using Twinmotion after modeling with 3Dmax modeling software, which shows the simplicity and operability of Twinmotion. It also shows the work rendered using Twinmotion.

articleTitle: Dense-U-Net: A novel densely connected CNN for lung fields segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) benefits from its early diagnosis and accurate treatment of lung diseases. Accurate and reliable lung fields segmentation is a prerequisite which is convenient for further diagnosis and treatment. However, due to the superimposed regions in lung fields and varied shapes among different patients, it is difficult to ensure the consistency in appearance and spatial. Besides, while deep learning models have achieved high performance in computer vision, the large number of parameters are generated during training process, which increases memory usage. In this paper, a novel densely connected CNN (Dense-U-Net) is proposed, which is beneficial to increase information flow throughout the model network and reduce redundancies by utilizing dense connections between different layers. This network adopts two kinds of dense connections and designs a model with a smaller number of parameters. Compared with some previous methods on the JSRT dataset, the proposed method shows higher performance for lung fields segmentation with different assessment indicators.

articleTitle: Mood Relief Game Design Based on Leap Motion and Unity3D
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Anxiety disorder and autism caused by increasing social pressure have been plagued by adults and children. Therefore, this article proposes a design method for emotion relief games based on Leap Motion and Unity3D. Firstly, use 3Dmax to make personalized virtual elements; secondly, extract the key of the hand based on the gesture coordinates and direction information captured by Leap Motion; finally, combine the Unity3D development environment to complete the gesture recognition and drive the virtual hand to achieve the pressure effect of gesture hitting the virtual element. This has important practical significance for the rehabilitation of anxiety and autism.

articleTitle: 3D Modeling Based on UAV Aerial Photography
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of land planning, natural disasters and campus building safety in China in the past two years, the aerial image of unmanned aerial vehicle is combined with outdoor 3D reconstruction technology. Based on hierarchical key frame selection algorithm and linear segmentation feature point detection extraction algorithm, images were selected and feature points were extracted and matched, and a set of efficient, convenient and real 3D reconstruction platform for outdoor large-scale scenes was established, which can play an important role in bridge inspection, geological inspection and building planning.

articleTitle: A Cross Partial Path Weighted Feature Fusion Object Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In order to solve insufficient data features utilization efficiency and improve the performance of the deep neural network in image recognition, we propose a cross partial path weighted feature fusion (CPP) algorithm based on the Yolo framework. Firstly, CPP deepens the down-sampling depth of the backbone framework; then two weighted sampling partial paths are built in the feature fusion network, and the corresponding FPN layers are weighted and fused to form an output feature maps; finally, the output feature maps of different sizes are used to obtain more accurate bounding box position and category information. The experimental analysis results show that the advantage of our algorithm is to extend the network depth of the model as well as the network width. Our model be able to fuse more feature information so that it improves the recognition accuracy of object detection.

articleTitle: Cloud mobile display and interaction framework of virtual reality 3D scenes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: We propose a framework for cloud mobile virtual reality (VR) applications on smart phone web browsers. It combines cloud rendering and panoramic stereo imaging technology to realize interactive high-quality 3D scene display on smart phones. The images of the VR 3D scenes are transmitted in the manner of video stream, and the interactive data is processed by the proposed anti-jitter algorithm (AJA). A web-side lightweight rendering approach is also realized in our framework. Use of our framework can both reduce the computational cost of displaying VR 3D scenes on smart phones, meanwhile eliminating the need of installing plug-ins or dedicated APPs. Our framework can interactively display VR 3D scenes on a smart phone web browser and provide satisfactory immersive experience for observers with the help of VR glasses.

articleTitle: LBWGAN: Label Based Shape Synthesis From Text With WGANs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In this work, we purpose a novel method of voxel-based shape synthesis, which can build a connection between the natural language text and the color shapes. The state-of-the-art method use Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to achieve this task and some achievements have been made with it. It is a very advanced framework on this subject but the state-of-the-art method significantly ignores the role of the class labels. Labels can guide shape synthesis because shapes in different labels have different characteristics. Therefore, this work attempts to create a deeper connection between the labels and the generated results. It based on a new structure and lets the labels guide the shape synthesis work. A key idea is to establish a new set of relationships outside the generator and discriminator to guide the training process. This paper introduces an independent class classifier in the new structure and makes it grow together with the generator to make the generated results have more distinctive class features. Experiments show that our method has a more exquisite performance on the synthesis of complex shapes, performing more realistic, and has better performance in structural integrity. Besides, our approach can extract the implied shape messages from the descriptions to realize shape synthesis.

articleTitle: Flight planning system for UAV to collect 3D reconstruction data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can use their flexible maneuverability to effectively collect images of urban buildings, and use the current multi-view stereo method to generate advanced 3D urban models. But the quality of the generated 3D model largely depends on a flight plan. This paper proposes a method to automatically generate a rough 3D contour based on the 2D contour of the building extracted from the orthophoto of the drone, and plan a shooting viewpoint for 3D reconstruction based on the contour information. The optimized ant colony algorithm is used to plan the optimal power consumption cost path of the viewpoint, and the UE4 game engine is used to simulate the planning result. This method can effectively simplify the flight planning process and minimize the small UAV in the acquisition process The problem of excessive consumption caused by alternate lifting.

articleTitle: Red Heroes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The overall protection of red culture has always been a difficult problem. This work explores the possibility of fast executable data visual storage for large red culture scene by combining entity modeling and real scene modeling technology.

articleTitle: Interest Screening and Analysis System for Autistic Children Based on Eye Movement Tracking
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Because children with autism cannot carry out normal language and social activities, parents and teachers cannot fully understand their specific interests. But the eyes can express their thoughts and feelings and subtle feelings that are difficult to express with words. By tracking children's eye trajectories in real time, they can perform natural eye movement interactions in contextual classified scenes, and perform interest screening and analysis based on the gaze data of the hierarchical interest screening content. After a comparative experiment, the subjects' real eye movement intentions are consistent with the test intentions. According to this method, the children with autism can communicate effectively with their points of interest.

articleTitle: VR cycling system with Cross-platform. Multi-scene and Highly Immersive
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: With the promotion of national fitness and the development of socialization of sport, physical and mental health has gradually become an important demand of the Chinese people in the new era in pursuit of a better life. As a simple and efficient way of fitness and entertainment, VR spinning bikes are not restricted by the weather, time, place, and air pollution, and are slightly loved by the public. However, the current virtual cycling system based on dynamic cycling still has problems such as a single riding scene, inconsistent visual somatosensory, and poor portability. In response to the lack of interactivity and presence of traditional virtual cyclingsystems, this article has developed a cross-platform Multi-scenario VR cycling system with high immersion. The system has multiple riding environments for users to choose personally. The core solves the problem of inconsistent VR riding body sensation, improves the user's immersion and reduces the user's dizziness In addition, the system can run on a varietyof platforms to meet the needs of users' personalized riding.

articleTitle: A new type of intelligent solar tracking bracket
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: With the rapid development of society and economy, many problems including environmental destruction and energy shortage have been revealed. It is inevitable to replace fossil fuels by developing new energy sources such as solar energy and so on. The key is how to maximize the solar energy since the utilization and storage of it are very limited. Here, an intelligent and feasible solar tracking device is designed to target this puzzle by rotating freely in two-dimension. Availability of solar energy has been improved by collecting solar continually at optimum angle in our device.

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction and Understanding of Indoor Scene Based on Single Image
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Given a photo of a room, through our automated system, try to reconstruct a three-dimensional scene similar to the photo. Among them, the indoor objects come from the objects in the ShapeNet model library, which enables our system to produce a high-quality output result. The method we use is to use a full convolutional neural network to train images and compare indicators, use Faster-RCNN to perform multitasking object recognition and target detection, and then iteratively optimize the position and proportion of objects in the room, so that the scene renders a three-dimensional map Best match with input photo.

Author Keywords: 3D reconstruction and understanding of indoor scenes
multitask object recognition and target detection neural network Faster RCNN

articleTitle: Integrated Application of BIM and VR Technology in Architectural Interactive Design and Construction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: VR(Virtual Reality) technology is an important direction of simulation technology, which mainly has the characteristics of multi-perception, immersion, interactivity, autonomy and so on. Through the VR helmet and joystick, the experiencer's visual system and motion perception system are connected to experience the effect More realistic. At present, this technology is mainly used in medical, aerospace, military, entertainment and other industries, and the construction industry is another promising test field. Most of the work of traditional VR technology stays at the level of processing surface effects, shielding related data and information, while BIM technology happens to make up for its shortcomings. The completed VR scene can solve actual engineering problems, and the information in the VR scene The integration of management and information communication issues with BIM technology shows unlimited engineering value, so this article is based on actual engineering, combines BIM technology with VR technology, interacts in real time throughout the building design and construction process, and optimizes the construction plan at any time, Check the progress of the project at any time, to reduce the economic efficiency of rework and other situations.

articleTitle: Image segmentation method based on RGB - D fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: There is too little information to use in the existing image segmentation algorithms, and it can not achieve the ideal segmentation effect. Kinect depth cameras could obtain surrounding RGB image and depth image in real-time, providing a new approach for image segmentation. In this paper, based on fusion image segmentation algorithm with RGB image and the depth image by Kinect, during the time of image segmentation in the fusion of color and depth information, first of all to align the depth image and RGB image, then to segment the image in advance with significant weighted method of the depth image, finally to make four-valued logic image segmentation. Contrast with other methods, this is simpler and more effective, and could provide accurate criterion for subsequent region merging and image recognition, and it is robuster.

articleTitle: Changchun University Virtual 3D Campus
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In the modern digital era, the demand of 3D campus is increasing. In this paper, a Changchun University Virtual 3D Campus was developed. The study realized a campus roaming and basic interactive functions. This study is based on Unity3D platform.

articleTitle: Object tracking with dynamic weighting Siamese network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Siamese-based models achieves outstanding performance in visual tracking. However, as the template is invariant during tracking, results in failing to capture the appearance changes over time, leading to incredible results. To tackle this problem, an object tracking method with dynamic weighting Siamese network has been proposed. First, we design a temporal attention module to obtain the time-sensitive features, which is learned by adaptively weighting the consecutive historical reference frames. Then, a spatial attention module is adopted to enhance the spatial information of the target, and promote the discriminative ability of the network. Finally, the Focal Loss is utilized to train the network offline, to improve the ability of handling the hard negative samples. We conducted the experiment on OTB2015 benchmark to evaluate the performance of the proposed method and other state-of-the-arts, comparison results demonstrate the good performance of our model.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual 3D Roaming Application of Dai National Folk House Based on Unity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Based on Unity, users can appreciate the glamour of art and culture of Dai residential areas in the house with the application about architecture named Virtual 3D Roaming of Dai National Folk Houses.

articleTitle: Dynamic Flight Simulator
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This article introduces a dynamic flight simulator. The dynamic flight simulator is composed of three-degree-of-freedom platform, flight seat, flight stick, VR glasses, physical simulation platform and other equipment. Experienced people operate the flight joystick, and can experience realistic flight vision through VR glasses. The three-degree-of-freedom platform brings high-realistic flight perception and experience through real dynamic simulation.

articleTitle: Virtual simulation experiment on plateau specific sports injury and plateau training monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This experiment is through virtual reality, human-computer interaction, database and network communication technology, the construction of altitude sickness and plateau, plateau sporting injuries in sports training monitoring experimental environment, object and reconstruct the plateau environment movement in all kinds of special damage process of emergency treatment and altitude training and medical surveillance scenes, using words, pictures, audio, video and virtual interaction to help plateau tourism groups, student, athletes and coaches to understand all kinds of operation principle and process.

articleTitle: Virtual Tourism Immersive Experience System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The case is a scene in the Old Summer Palace that no longer exists in the world-Huifang Academy, combined with the ancient pictures of one of the forty scenes of the Old Summer Palace that have been handed down to restore this scene in the most beautiful garden in the East. We used the current popular next-generation art technology combined with the rendering effects of the Unreal 4 engine and the VR architecture to restore Huifang Academy, and strive to restore. We also refer to the architectural structure characteristics and culture of the Ming and Qing Dynasties to make architectural models, and according to In time and month, we also rendered 24 display pictures representing 24 solar terms. And output runnable VR/AR files, panoramic pictures, 360 videos, etc., to show the charm of VR tourism.

articleTitle: A dynamic visualization system for risk characterization and accident evolution of molten metal operation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The dynamic visualization system for risk characterization and accident evolution of molten metal operation takes steel smelting and electrolytic aluminum as scenes, taking the four typical accidents of explosion, spitting, tilting and leakage as the objects, 3Dmax+Substance Painter2 are used for modeling and mapping, and Unity3d+C# are used for development. The system consists of steel smelting and electrolytic aluminum subsystems, including the functional modules such as hazard & risk characterization, accident rehearsal, accident reconstruction, safety cognition, etc. It is expected to provide operators, managers and other relevant personnel with effective tools for accident evolution analysis, accident deduction analysis, and safety cognition, to reduce accidents.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Ship-Ice Collision Based on Conservation of Energy in Navigation Scene
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In navigation simulator, sea ice model is deferent from other invariable models that they would not change their structure, such as ships, coastal buildings, harbor environment and so on. Because of ship-ice collision in ice navigation scene, sea ice will be broken and floating in the sea water, then ice channel will be generated, what should be modeled and visualized in scene of navigation simulator necessarily. Focusing on above problems, the conservation of energy would be applied in the analysis of physical characteristics of ship-ice collision process, what could be the base of sea ice broken and ice channel generated visualization in ice navigation scene.

articleTitle: Real-time Physics Engine Based on MPM and PBD
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: We have proposed a real-time physics engine that can handle various materials and phenomena, including deformable objects, granular objects and water. Furthermore, based on the latest MLS-MPM method proposed by academia, our engine can handle the coupling of water and sand.

articleTitle: City of The Future
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This work aims to visually show the conceptof the future city using image technology, and outline all aspects of human habitation, life and office in the future. What we envision is a community space that integrates work, leisure and entertainment without being restricted by the terrain space. Perfect interpretation of the future city, future life.

articleTitle: Instance Segmentation Based on Improved YOLACT
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: YOLACT is the first real-time algorithm in instance segmentation. Aiming at the limitations in the algorithm such as low accuracy and poor stability for overlapping objects, an improved instance segmentation approach based on YOLACT was proposed. Specifically, the receptive field block is employed in the backbone network to extract multi-scale local region features, so that the network can learn more discriminative and robust features. To evaluate the validity of algorithm, experiments are performed on Pascal 2012 SBD. The results indicate the improved network can produce finer mask predictions in complex environment while keeping the real-time speed.

articleTitle: Virtual Experiment Platform For Middle School Entrance Examination
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The virtual experiment platform of the middle school entrance examination is a platform for junior high school students to simulate the experiment. It integrates the experimental knowledge of the middle school entrance examination into the virtual experiment, so that students can have a clearer understanding of the experimental phenomena and conclusions, and master the basic use of the experimental instruments of the middle school entrance examination. And cultivate students' ability of observation, practical ability and the ability of linking experiment with theoretical knowledge.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Application Based On Improved SSD Network Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This article first briefly introduces the face recognition system. By improving the traditional model of the SSD network, the lightweight MobileNet network model replaces the original VGG network model, and the Elu activation function replaces the Relu function in the original model to better accelerate training and improve The accuracy of classification can determine the location of the face more accurately and quickly, better change the traditional image preprocessing method, and improve the accuracy of face recognition. Finally, a comparison of common backbone networks shows that the algorithm in this experiment has a greater improvement in face recognition accuracy than other backbone networks.

articleTitle: A Tangible Interaction Projection Tabletop for Experiments
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: A tangible interaction projection tabletop system is developed for middle school experiments. The system supports both tangible interaction of physical objects, which are printe d by 3D printers, and finger pointing interaction on the tabletop. Object textures, as well as invisible experiments phenomena, which cannot be easily observed in real experiments (e.g. magnetic induction line), are projected by projectors. Compared with completely virtual experiments, the system has natural and tangible experimental operations. Compared with real experiments, the system can enhance the display of objective phenomena which are difficult to be observed in real experiment.

articleTitle: 3D Surface Detail Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In 3D surface reconstruction, the sampling and quantization in the process of digitization limits the surface details obtained by the visual sensor. Obtaining a fine-grained 3D surface at lower cost remains a difficult problem. In our work, we have introduced a new method for enhancing 3D surface details reconstructed from single normal map without the support of hardware and reflection models. Using the new measurement of angle profile to infer microstructures hidden from existing surfaces. In addition, discrete geometry processing (DGP) can be used to further improve inference results. Numerous simulation results show that our method has achieved significant improvements on both subjective visual evaluation and objective quality metrics.

articleTitle: Shadow play
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Shadow play is a 2D animation with AE and animation as the main content and PS and AI as the auxiliary. The style of this short film tells the rise and fall and development of shadow play art against the background of the Qing Dynasty, the Ming Dynasty and the founding of new China. The inspiration of the short film comes from the intangible cultural heritage at the beginning. Shadow play art is gradually ignored by people in the 21st century, calling on people to protect our intangible cultural heritage. Shadow play has been produced in the Western Han Dynasty, but with today's society into the information age, people spend most of their time on electronic information products, lack of attention to China's non-material culture, making shadow play art once again to decline. The original intention of this animation is to appeal to people to feel the real world, pay attention to our traditional culture, and consciously protect our material culture and intangible culture.

articleTitle: Design of Auxiliary Hearing Compensation System Based on Bluetooth for Deaf Children
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: this paper studies a kind of hearing aid device based on Bluetooth technology and single chip microcomputer. According to the degree of hearing loss of hearing-impaired children, appropriate gain is selected to realize sound amplification, so that children with hearing impairment can hear the outside sound clearly and provide convenience for their life. This design adopts the design idea of the host and slave, the audio amplification parameters in the host are wireless transmitted to the slave through Bluetooth technology, and the audio code coding chip is given instructions. By selecting the appropriate audio signal amplification gain, the audio signal is amplified and processed, so that the hearing-impaired children can hear the external sound clearly. In this design scheme, the system hardware module design mainly includes the system control module, audio module, power module, Bluetooth communication module, etc., among which the audio module also includes the microphone input signal conditioning circuit, audio codec circuit, audio interface circuit, etc. The software platform uses the STM32F103xx firmware library provided by STMicroelectronics Company, and uses the library function provided by it and the corresponding instance to modify and debug.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of the Development and Hot Spots of Chinese enterprises' Management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Under the background of Internet economy, accelerating the pace of scientific and technological innovation of enterprises and realizing the artificial intelligence of enterprise operation and management have become the common goals pursued by entrepreneurs and scientific researchers. This paper takes seven Chinese management core journals as samples. The articles in these journals published between January 2000 and December 2019, are used as a database and analyzed by the CiteSpace of knowledge map to detect and visualize the important changes and development trends in the development of enterprise operation and management. It is concluded that the hot spots of Chinese enterprise management mode in the past two decades mainly include supply chain, technological innovation, management science, e-commerce and capital structure and so on. Moreover, innovation and Internet economy are the key points of enterprise management in the future. This study reveals that the reason that hinders the development and expansion of Chinese enterprises is that the investment in financial assets and physical assets occupies the proportion of investment in scientific research and development, leading to the low degree of technological innovation and management innovation of enterprises. Therefore, this paper has a guiding effect on the reform and development of enterprises and helps enterprises to enhance their innovation driving force.

articleTitle: Virtual monitoring of support group based on distributed real-time running data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In view of the problems in traditional monitoring methods of hydraulic support in fully mechanized mining face, such as non intuitive display of monitoring information, difficult transmission of monitoring data, and unsatisfactory monitoring effect, a unity3d virtual monitoring method based on real-time running data driven and network cooperation technology is proposed. Taking the monitoring of hydraulic support in a fully mechanized mining face as an example, firstly, the real-time running data of the support is used to drive the model movement, and the visual monitoring of the hydraulic support is realized under the unity3d environment; Then, considering the limitation of advanced explosion-proof computer configuration of underground centralized control center, a distributed virtual monitoring method of hydraulic support group is proposed based on the optimization of unity3d built-in network structure and dynamic allocation of monitoring tasks on consistency hash algorithm, which reduces the data monitoring amount and network transmission amount of single monitoring host, and realizes the real and virtual synchronous monitoring of hydraulic support group; Finally, the distributed virtual monitoring system is built, and the method is verified by experiments. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional monitoring method, this method can not be affected by the bad working face environment. On the basis of greatly reducing the amount of data transmission, it can realize the visual display of the attitude of the hydraulic support group.

articleTitle: Multiple water quality monitoring platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: It is imperative to protect and utilize the water resource because water resource shortage has been a society problem in Jilin Province. The accuracy and efficiency of water quality monitoring are increasingly demanded. How to predict scientifically is necessary for water resource management and emergency treatment.Until now the traditional water quality monitoring system has revealed many problems. Firstly, the safety of the floating platform is threatened due to the corrosion of the welding points under water. Secondly, the maintenance of equipment is expensive because underwater robots or divers are required. Thirdly, monitoring deviation is inevitable since the equipment is easy to be covered by the mud and sand. Finally, the labor costs for adjusting the monitoring depth are very high because different sensors are required at distributed water areas. In our work, a multiple water quality monitoring platform is developed to solve the above problems. The wave converter is used as the sensor by replacing the traditional current meter, which is based on mechanical rotation. The pulse wave emitted by wave converter is subsequently reflected and the signal is received as well as the flow velocity is calculated by measuringthe Doppler frequency shift. The equipment can directly measure the velocity of the cross-section without disturbing the flow field as well as its measuring process is rapid and measurement scope is wide. It can be widely used for detecting the flow field structure, velocity and flow testing in ocean and river.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Method of Fully Mechanized Coal Mining Equipment Workspace Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to extract the working attitude of fully mechanized coal mining equipment in real-time in the existing monitoring methods, a method for constructing the working space of fully mechanized coal mining equipment based on virtual reality is proposed. First, the key information points were patched on the hydraulic support and scraper conveyor model, and the space-time kinematics relationship between the fully mechanized coal mining equipment and the 3D geological model was built in the virtual reality engine Unity3d; Then the initial working curves of the hydraulic support and scraper conveyor were extracted, and the reliability of the method was verified by virtual experiments. Finally, the support space of hydraulic support and the working space of fully mechanized coal mining equipment are constructed by using the key point marking method. The results show that the working space constructed by this method can reflect the working trajectory of the equipment more realistically. This method provides a theoretical basis for extracting the working attitude of fully mechanized coal mining equipment in the fully mechanized coal mining face.

articleTitle: Virtual Camera Motion Planning Algorithm Based on Visual Trajectory Guidance
